the dam of tamattu when an f q performs a proxy hajj after an umrah in the months of hajj if an f q performs his umrah during the months of hajj and then performs a proxy hajj from makkah al mukarramah on behalf of a deceased person who had made no bequest for it will the dam of tamattu be obligatory or not when a person performs umrah during the months of hajj and then in that same year and without returning home enters the state of i r m for hajj and performs the hajj this is called tamattu that is deriving benefit from two acts of worship in a single journey since the person in question derived benefit from two acts of worship in a single journey on this basis a sacrifice of thanksgiving will be obligatory consider what the author of al hid yah may allah have mercy on him says

the ruling on hajj becoming obligatory upon a wealthy prisoner a man had been in prison for a long time on account of a murder case during that period a piece of his land was sold and he became the possessor of the ni b so that hajj became obligatory upon him as it happened the man died in prison itself now will hajj be performed on his behalf out of his wealth or not did hajj become obligatory upon him in prison or not and was a bequest for this hajj binding upon him or not in the view of im m ib may allah have mercy on him it was not binding upon him to perform hajj himself nor to have a proxy hajj performed nor to make a bequest for hajj in the view of the two companions may allah have mercy on them however if he was not able to do it himself then having a proxy hajj performed or making a bequest for hajj before dying was binding and necessary for him many of the shaykhs among the anaf jurists have adopted the view of the two companions may allah have mercy on them consider what fat w sh m states

the ruling on the cleanliness of the i r m for one who performs umrah frequently a person keeps performing more than one umrah many times the i r m becomes soiled or it becomes dirty because some drink or the like has spilled on it is it necessary each time to wash the i r m and to wear a clean one or is an umrah valid in such an i r m for entering the state of i r m it is recommended to use two white sheets either new ones or old ones that have been washed clean however if a person performs umrah again and again and gets no opportunity to wash them then using them without washing is also permissible though contrary to what is preferable and the umrah is valid without any dislikedness washing them before use nevertheless is superior and better consider what is transmitted in fat w sh m

the ruling on performing hajj with unlawful wealth if someone performed hajj with stolen wealth or with unlawful wealth has his hajj been fulfilled or not or will he have to perform hajj again the ruling on unlawful wealth is that it should be returned to its owner and if the owner is not known it should be given in charity on his behalf a person does not become the owner of such wealth nor does hajj become obligatory through it but if someone has performed hajj with unlawful wealth the obligation of hajj will be discharged from his liability he will not however receive the reward of the hajj and he will also be sinful consider what takmilat al ba r al r iq records

the ruling on the obligation of hajj upon a woman who has no ma ram it is recorded in the books of fiqh that if a person has provisions and a mount then hajj is obligatory upon him and concerning women it is recorded that if she has no ma ram available it is not permissible for her to go for hajj now in the light of these two rulings it is understood that if a woman has provisions and a mount for going to hajj then hajj becomes obligatory upon her but if she has no ma ram available then despite its being obligatory upon her it is not permissible for her to go for hajj the matters to be inquired into are now these 1 if after hajj has become obligatory no ma ram is available does the obligation of hajj fall away from her liability 2 if the the essential ruling is that hajj will become obligatory upon a woman by reason of her ability then even if she has no ma ram or husband available the obligation will still not fall away rather it is binding and necessary upon her to make a bequest this is because according to the preponderant view the presence of a ma ram or a husband is a condition for the performance of hajj and not for hajj becoming obligatory yes if she performs hajj without a ma ram the hajj will be fulfilled but the sin of travelling without a ma ram will be incurred consider what is transmitted in fat w al sh m

the ruling on a woman covering the shar travel distance without a shar ma ram what do the scholars of religion and the muftis of the firm shar ah say concerning the following matter if a woman has to travel by aeroplane from one place where she lives to another in order to visit her parents and the journey is of about 40 to 45 minutes may she travel by aeroplane without a ma ram or not given that her husband sees her off from the airport and at the other end her parents wait for her at the airport the woman is in ij b the route is safe and there is no fear of temptation in such a case what is the ruling in the pure shar ah it is not permissible for a muslim woman to cover the shar travel distance without a shar ma ram even if a ma ram is present at both ends the aeroplane journey will still be covered without a ma ram and this is impermissible a severe prohibition of this has come in the noble hadith muslim shar f states in this hadith the prohibition has come without any restriction accordingly in the case in question even

the ruling on using toothpaste while in the state of i r m is it permissible to use toothpaste while in the state of i r m or not given that it contains some fragrance if someone has used it will any penalty be obligatory or not in toothpaste what is intended is the cleaning of the teeth fragrance is not what is intended furthermore the fragrance is slight and overpowered and for this reason a dam or adaqah is neither obligatory nor binding though it is better to give something in charity if however the fragrance is dominant and intended then if it is applied to the whole mouth or to more than half of the mouth a dam will be obligatory and if to less than half a adaqah will be obligatory it is better that in the state of i r m one should confine oneself to the misw k bad i al an i records

the ruling on a dam becoming obligatory for shaving outside the boundaries of the aram a man performed umrah and shaved his head at his lodging outside the aram is anything obligatory upon him or not what should he do now according to the view on which fatwa is given shaving in umrah is restricted to the boundaries of the aram therefore for shaving outside the boundaries of the aram a dam will be obligatory consider what im m mu ammad may allah have mercy on him says in al mabs fat w sh m mentions

the ruling on performing an umrah upon an umrah without shaving if a man performed all the acts of umrah but before shaving his head entered the state of i r m for a second umrah and completed it is anything obligatory upon him or not in the case in question one dam will be binding upon the said person on account of combining two i r ms and this dam will be restricted to the aram consider the proofs in shar lub b mull al al q r may allah have mercy on him says

the ruling on the make up umrah and the dam upon returning after passing beyond the m q t a woman performed umrah and then went to if to visit when she came back she did not make the intention of umrah because she was not well she has now returned home what will be binding upon this woman will there be a dam or not it should be clear that if lies outside the m q t therefore when pilgrims and those performing umrah who go to if for a visit re enter with the intention of makkah al mukarramah it is binding upon them to enter the state of i r m and to perform an umrah to pass beyond the m q t without i r m is a sin and if one does not return a dam becomes binding however since the lady in question went back without having performed an umrah the making up of one umrah will now be obligatory upon her and when she returns in the state of i r m the dam will fall away consider the proofs all mah sarakhs may allah have mercy on him says in al mabs

the ruling on coming out of i r m when there are many sores on the head if a person has had a wig of artificial hair fitted and has a great many sores on his head on account of which shaving or trimming after the hajj is extremely difficult or they are healing somewhat but even so for certain reasons he is unable to trim or shave then how will this person come out of i r m from the writings of the jurists it emerges that a person who has no hair on his head or who has hair but for whom trimming or shaving is not possible on account of sores or illness should pass a razor over his head and if even this is not possible he will become al l just as he is further if someone has no natural hair on his head but has had a wig of artificial hair fitted then if he can remove it easily it is necessary to take it off and pass a razor over the head and if removing it is not possible or is difficult he should pass a razor over the wig itself and if even this is not possible on account of sores or illness he will become al l just as he is accordingly in t

the ruling on zamzam when plain water is mixed with it i have heard that in the view of the arab scholars if ordinary water is mixed with zamzam then the water of zamzam does not remain in its own condition it too becomes ordinary water whereas our scholars call it zamzam even then now what is the ruling on this and if it remains zamzam after mixing what is the ruling on mixing ordinary water with it and selling it by mixing a small amount of plain water with zamzam the blessing of zamzam is not lost it will still remain blessed provided that the admixture is the overpowered part and zamzam is dominant for the jurists have taken account of what is dominant and what is overpowered in this matter however to sell adulterated water as zamzam without disclosing the fact is not correct there is deception in it it is like a man who mixes a little water into milk and drinks it this will still be called drinking milk but to mix water into milk and sell it is not permissible it is sinful and is deception because the buyer is purchasing it in the belief that it is genuine and unadulterated from th

details of the marriages of the prophet to the pure wives on which date and in which month did the marriages of the noble prophet to the pure wives take place which year was it and did they take place by day or by night concerning the order of the noble prophet's marriages to the pure wives there is some difference among the historians but all agree that the number of the mothers of the believers was eleven furthermore of these eleven a rat khad jah al kubr may allah the exalted be pleased with her and a rat zaynab bint khuzaymah may allah the exalted be pleased with her had already passed away during the blessed lifetime of the messenger and at the time of his demise nine mothers of the believers were living on leafing through the books of s rah and history some details concerning the month and year of the marriages were obtained regarding whether the marriage took place by day or by ni

a verification of the marriage sermon at the nik of a rat khad jah may allah the exalted be pleased with her who conducted the marriage of the messenger of allah to a rat khad jah may allah the exalted be pleased with her a reference for this is required and is the reference sound or is there criticism of it if there is criticism what is that criticism also what was that sermon concerning the marriage of a rat khad jah may allah be pleased with her there are four views in the books of s rah and history 1 the first view is that her paternal cousin waraqah ibn nawfal conducted her marriage this is the inclination of all mah suy the delivery of the sermon is ascribed to ab lib but this narration is weak 2 the second view is that her brother amr ibn khuwaylid conducted the marriage this is mentioned in most books with the wording of weakness 3 the third view which is very well known is that her father khuwaylid conducted her marriage while in a state of intoxication but ibn kath r may allah have mercy on him and im m dhahab may allah have

the ruling on holding the marriage gathering on friday evening i have read this hadith somewhere its meaning is that a marriage should be conducted at the time of evening so is it recommended to conduct a marriage in the evening or at night and has the merit of a marriage on friday evening come in any narration or not the hadith mentioned in the question is recorded with its chain of narration in tafs r al tha lab but it is weak yes in the matter of virtues a weak hadith is taken into consideration on this basis conducting a marriage in the evening will be recommended and a means of good and blessing apart from this the jurists have stated that it is recommended to conduct a marriage on friday and some of our elders may allah have mercy on them have said that it is recommended to hold the marriage gathering on friday in the evening since the hour of acceptance falls on friday evening perhaps it is for this reason that they said so consider the noble hadith this hadith is recorded with its c

the marriage sermon at the nik of a rat f imah and a rat umm ab bah may allah the exalted be pleased with them both which sermon should be recited at the time of conducting a marriage and from where is it established which sermon did the noble prophet recite at the time of the marriage of a rat f imah may allah the exalted be pleased with her i have heard that the marriage of umm ab bah may allah the exalted be pleased with her was conducted by the negus so did he recite a sermon or not and if he did which one before the marriage contract it is sunnah to deliver a sermon containing the praise of allah the exalted and blessings and salutations upon the prophet yes the one that is well known from abdull h ibn mas d may allah be pleased with him under the name of khu bat al jah to recite that is better that sermon is mentioned in a narration of ab d w d shar f consider the following

the ruling on a marriage being contracted where the agent acts as a witness can an agent be a witness or not that is in one gathering the bridegroom was present and there was one witness and on behalf of the girl there was an agent who was also a witness apart from these three no one else was present was the marriage contracted or not in the case in question the marriage was not contracted it will remain suspended upon the bride's permission when the bride grants permission she will become the contracting party and the agent together with the one witness will make two witnesses and the marriage will be contracted consider what al durr al mukht r records

an engagement is a promise of marriage not a marriage a man became engaged to a girl eight or ten people were present at the engagement gathering the girl's father said very well we have given the girl to the boy the boy said we have accepted her there was no sermon no register and nothing else now the girl's family wish to break off the engagement while the boy's family say that an offer and acceptance took place at the engagement so this is a marriage and it cannot now be broken what is the ruling of the shar ah did a marriage take place or not can the girl marry elsewhere or not in an engagement what is intended is a promise of marriage therefore in the case in question no marriage was contracted only a promise of marriage was made yes one should not break a promise without a valid shar excuse fulfilling a promise is recommended if there is the intention of causing hurt it will be sinful otherwise not all mah sh m may allah have mercy on him says in his fat w

the ruling on a marriage when the explicit word for marriage is used at an engagement if at an engagement the two parties use the word for marriage but there is no mention of dowry sermon or the testimony of witnesses and an offer and acceptance take place will a marriage be contracted or not by using the explicit word for marriage at an engagement the marriage will be contracted even if no mention was made of the dowry giving the dowry is still necessary the marriage sermon is a sunnah and mentioning the testimony is not necessary a marriage is valid in the presence of two men or of one man and two women all mah sh m may allah have mercy on him says kif yat al muft records however if in the engagement gathering the explicit word for marriage is used for example the husband or his guardian say

the ruling on making an offer and acceptance by text message on the telephone a boy sent a message to a girl saying say i have accepted the marriage without any purpose or intention the girl sent the message i have accepted was a marriage contracted or not for this girl now wishes to marry someone else may she do so in the case in question no marriage was contracted the reason for this is that for a marriage to be contracted it is necessary that the offer and acceptance take place verbally in a single gathering before witnesses so that the witnesses hear it and this element is absent here in bad i al an i all mah ab bakr al k s n may allah have mercy on him while discussing the conditions of marriage says

a verification of the hadith in which marriage is described as half of faith has it come in any hadith that marriage is half of faith or is there any narration to the same effect if there is what is its grade im m abar n may allah have mercy on him has transmitted in his book a narration whose purport is this whoever marries has completed half of faith so now let him fear allah the exalted in respect of the remaining half but this narration is weak consider the wording of the narration im m abar n has transmitted this narration with two chains but both chains ar

the ruling on a marriage contract by means of a skype call if a person contracts a marriage by means of a skype call in which the parties converse while seeing each other's faces in which two witnesses hear the conversation of the contracting parties and also see their faces will a marriage be contracted in such a case or not for a marriage to be contracted it is necessary that the two contracting parties make the offer and acceptance in one and the same gathering before two witnesses and that the two witnesses hear it if the gathering is different the marriage will not be contracted and in a skype call this condition is not met therefore a marriage will not be contracted by means of a skype call yes if the girl appoints someone at the boy's location as her agent and the agent then contracts the marriage in the marriage gathering before two witnesses the marriage will take place consider what bad i al an i states

the ruling on a marriage with non muslims as witnesses a newly muslim girl was married to a muslim man and among the witnesses to the marriage were her brother and her father both of whom were non muslims and both of whom insisted on being the witnesses the one who conducted the marriage was a muslim in this situation did the marriage take place or not if in the register the names of the non muslim brother and father were entered in the column for witnesses but other muslims were present in the marriage gathering then the marriage took place by the testimony of all of them if however the marriage gathering contained only the bridegroom the bride and the non muslim brother and father and no one else besides them then the marriage did not take place and the marriage should be performed again in the presence of two muslim witnesses consider what is mentioned in al hid yah

the ruling on a marriage in which the girl's name is not mentioned in the marriage gathering a certain sufi gentleman conducted the marriage of a girl to a boy while conducting the marriage he did not mention the girl's name rather he said i have given so and so's daughter in marriage to you and he said that a girl's name is something to be concealed and that a girl's name should not be called out in the marriage gathering now my question to you is this in the era of the messenger of allah and the noble companions was the girl's name mentioned or not and what have the jurists written in this connection in the era of the messenger of allah and the noble companions may allah the exalted be pleased with them the girl's name used to be mentioned at the time of the marriage moreover the noble jurists too have said that if the witnesses do not know the girl then mentioning the girl's name and her father's name is necessary so that it may be known who is being married likewise if someone has several daughters it will not be known which girl is being married hence mentioning the name is necessary yes if someone has only one daughter and everyone knows that it is she who is being married then mentioning the father's name is sufficient the prophet mentioned the name of a rat f i

the ruling on writing the girl's name on a wedding invitation nowadays the names of the bridegroom and the bride are written on the wedding invitation for the purpose of identification some people raise the objection that writing the girl's name is not correct is it established anywhere from sound hadiths or from the reports of the companions that writing the girl's name on an invitation has been forbidden in the era of the messenger of allah and the noble companions there were no cards or the like at all yes from the style of the noble qur'an it emerges that the matter of women is founded upon concealment accordingly wherever it became necessary to mention women their names were avoided for example and and so forth yes only the name of a rat maryam bint imr n is mentioned therefore publishing women's names on announcements and the like is not a good thing however if in a wedding invitation the names of the bridegroom and bride together with their fathers' names are written for the sake of identificati

the ruling on regarding marriage in mu arram al ar m as undesirable generally in india and pakistan people do not hold weddings in mu arram especially in the first ten days and regard it as a defect or as inauspicious what is the ruling of the shar ah on this and did the marriage of any of the pure wives or the pure daughters take place in mu arram or not in the pure shar ah there is no month that is inauspicious and in which marriage has been forbidden on the contrary taking omens of ill fortune is not permissible in the shar ah this is the way of others and is not islamic culture quite the reverse from the narrations it emerges that the marriages of some of the pure wives and of some of the pure daughters took place in mu arram consider the narrations the marriage of umm al mu min n a rat umm ab bah may allah the exalted be pleased with her took place in mu arram al ra q al makht m transmits

the ruling on marrying one's step maternal uncle a girl's mother passed away and her father at an advanced age married a young woman who has a brother is it permissible or not for this girl to marry her stepmother's brother that is her step maternal uncle in the case in question the stepmother's brother is not this girl's real maternal uncle for this reason the marriage is permissible and valid outwardly there is no ground for the marriage being impermissible consider what is stated in fat w d r al ul m deoband question a man has two wives from the first wife he has three daughters while the second wife is childless now is it valid or not for one of the first wife's daughters to be married to a real brother of the second wife answer it is valid for the second wife's brother to marry one of the first wife's daughters there is no ground in it for the prohibition of marriag

the ruling on marrying the wife's step granddaughter may a man marry his wife's step granddaughter the daughter of his wife's stepdaughter or not it is learnt from the statements of the noble jurists that a man may marry his wife's stepdaughter since there is no kinship or relationship between the two therefore in the case in question marrying the wife's step granddaughter will likewise be permissible and valid consider all mah sarakhs may allah have mercy on him says in al mabs

the ruling on a wife's claiming maintenance after the marriage but before she has moved to her husband's home a girl's nikah took place and valid seclusion also occurred but she has not formally gone to the boy's home in another country three months have now passed since the marriage the question is may she claim the maintenance for the past three months or not furthermore what will be the ruling regarding maintenance in the future it emerges from the statements of the noble jurists that maintenance is a right in return for the wife's being confined to the husband that is it is a right consequent upon her handing herself over if the girl has not handed herself over maintenance will not be binding yes if the girl is ready to go and the husband does not take her or if the move does not take place on account of some other constraint then the girl may claim maintenance however for claiming maintenance for a past period there are two conditions 1 that the two of them had settled between themselves that he would pay a fixed sum each month and he then failed to pay it 2 that the judge had imposed a specified

the ruling on the waiting period required for marrying a divorced christian woman a christian woman filed a suit to obtain a divorce from her husband and the court decreed the divorce now that christian woman wishes to marry a muslim man is it necessary for her to observe a waiting period of three menstrual cycles or not that is what is the ruling of the pure shar ah regarding the waiting period after divorce in the case of a non muslim christian woman in the case in question according to im m ab an fah may allah have mercy on him a waiting period is not obligatory upon a non muslim christian woman yes in order to marry a muslim she should wait until she has become pure from one menstruation and if the marriage has already been contracted immediately then it is necessary to wait until she has become pure from one menstruation before intercourse consider what is stated in fat w al sh m all ma

the ruling on separation when the husband has become incapable of intercourse a woman's husband was injured in an accident on account of which his private organ was severed or he became incapable of intercourse the two of them also have children and the woman is young she demanded divorce or khul from her husband but the husband refused in this situation is there any way in the shar ah for the woman to obtain release from this man or not does this woman have the right to place her case before the muslim community and have the marriage annulled or not furthermore what procedure should the muslim community adopt in this matter according to the shar ah in the case in question the established position of the anaf s is that when after the marriage the husband has had marital relations once and thereafter becomes unable to do so for some reason the woman is not permitted to demand annulment the jurists in general have written to this effect in the books of fiqh and moreover several reports of the successors in mu annaf ibn ab shaybah support it accordingly in the case in question since marital relations have taken place repeatedly and the two of them also have children the woman should exercise patience and should devote her attention to the upbringing of the children for in that there is also protection of the children from bein

the ruling on a father's contracting his daughter's marriage without her consent a few years ago a girl was engaged to her paternal cousin then relations between the two families deteriorated later the girl learnt that two years earlier her father had contracted her marriage and had also signed the papers this girl neither accepted that marriage at the time nor does she accept it now did such a marriage take place or not the marriage of a sane adult girl is not permissible or valid without her consent accordingly in the case in question the marriage contracted without the girl's permission was not concluded and the girl has the right to marry elsewhere according to her own wish yes if the girl marries into a family that is not her equal the guardian has the right to raise an objection consider what is stated in the noble hadith

an objection concerning the marriage to the wife of an adopted son and its answer why did the noble prophet marry the wife of his adopted son some non muslims raise this as an objection what is a good answer by which a non muslim may be made to understand the simple answer for making a non muslim understand is this can any person in the world have two real fathers that is utterly impossible how then could a rat zayd have both rithah and the holy prophet as his father moreover the thing that would truly be objectionable is that another man's son should be made one's own son what objection can there be in calling another man's son the son of that other man as for the substantive answer it is this it was a custom of the age of ignorance that if a man called someone his son that person was regarded as his real son he was given all the same rights that were given to a real son and he was made a sharer in inheritance and the like

the ruling on marrying a girl's mother after having contracted marriage with the girl and then divorcing her a man contracted marriage with a girl and then divorced her before she had even moved to his home he now wishes to marry her mother is this permissible or not this marriage is not permissible because a wife's mother becomes unlawful by the mere contract of marriage whether or not the wife has moved to her husband's home the noble qur n states sunan al tirmidh

the ruling on marrying the brother of one's foster sister a girl received a proposal of marriage from her maternal cousin while the boy's sister and this girl are foster sisters is this marriage permissible in the case in question it is permissible to marry the foster sister of one's own real sister who is also one's maternal cousin there is no ground for impermissibility an illustration of this is as follows s jidah and bidah are two sisters s jidah has a daughter mu minah and bidah has a daughter sh kirah and a son sh kir now s jidah suckled her own daughter mu minah and her niece sh kirah so the two of them became foster sisters it is therefore permissible and valid for sh kir to marry mu minah the foster sister of his own real sister sh kirah who is also sh kir's maternal cousin consider what is stated in al bin yah shar al hid yah

the ruling on the establishment of revocation by the words i love you a man gave his wife a revocable divorce then nine or ten days later the husband said to his wife over the telephone i love you did a valid revocation take place over the telephone by these words or not just as revocation is established by explicit expressions so too it is established by allusive expressions when accompanied by the intention accordingly in the case in question i love you is an allusive expression if the husband intended revocation when he uttered these words then revocation has been established and there is now no need for a fresh marriage contract consider what is stated in fat al qad r

the ruling on permissible enjoyment during the days of menstruation during the days of menstruation may a husband satisfy his desire with his wife's hands or between her thighs or not likewise if the wife is menstruating may she satisfy her desire by touching her husband or not during the days of menstruation a husband may derive enjoyment from his wife's body by touching it directly apart from the region between the navel and the knees direct enjoyment of the region between the navel and the knees without a covering is not permissible nevertheless the superior and better course is that even when desire overpowers him the husband should keep away from his wife while she is menstruating for therein lies safety in this noble verse the muslims have been taught the middle way

the ruling on living in one house with the husband's brother a man keeps his brother with him in his house his wife says that the house is small and that this is a source of distress for her especially since the brother does no work and stays at home the whole day so that observing purdah all day long is also difficult what should be done now keeping a brother in the same house as one's wife when the house is very small and there is also the fear of temptation is not correct rather he should be made to understand the matter with wisdom a prohibition has been transmitted in the noble hadith a rat uqbah b mir relates that the messenger of allah forbade men to go in to unrelated women a companion from among the an r asked o messenger of allah what is your view about the husband's brother he said the husband's bro

the ruling on keeping a daughter away from her father after divorce a divorce took place between a husband and wife for some reason they have a four year old daughter the woman has now remarried and has travelled with her husband and the daughter to another country where the girl's father has no access is it permissible for the girl's mother to act in this way kindly clarify the ruling on this the girl will remain in her mother's custody until the age of nine and during this period the father may meet the girl whenever he wishes taking the girl to another country without her father's consent is not permissible and to separate the girl from her father is an injustice consider what is stated in al hid yah

the ruling on stipulating that the father will not be given the children some discord arose between zayd and his wife and the wife went off to her parents' home even after a thousand efforts she was not prepared to return the wife laid down a condition that if for any reason a divorce should take place between the two of them then zayd that is the father would have no right to take the children being helpless zayd accepted the condition and she came back after living together for a few days she again for some reason took her children and went off to her parents' home the question now is if a divorce takes place will the father be entitled in the shar ah to take his children or not kindly favour us with an answer in the light of the qur n and h the pure shar ah has granted the father the right of rearing a son after seven years and a daughter after nine years hence the acceptance of a condition of this kind does not make its fulfilment obligatory and the father's right of custody will remain intact as before consider concerning the acceptance of conditions im m bukh r may allah have mercy on him established a chapter and cited a hadith

the ruling on a husband's compelling his wife to conjugal relations may a husband compel his wife to intercourse for example the wife is grief stricken or something has happened on account of which she is not ready at that moment furthermore what is the meaning of those hadiths in which a curse is mentioned if she does not come when she is called are these hadiths authentic or weak in ordinary circumstances a wife may not withhold herself from fulfilling her husband's need unless there is some natural or legal excuse in which case there is no harm this is precisely the meaning of the hadiths that if she refuses without an excuse it is a cause of the curse otherwise not the hadiths on this subject are authentic and fit to be adduced as proof consider what is stated in bukh r shar f

the ruling on embracing one's daughter in law a man is sixty years of age and his son has married the daughter in law is twenty five years old is it permissible for the father in law to embrace his daughter in law on occasions of rejoicing such as the two ds one's son's wife that is one's daughter in law is a ma ram and marriage with her is unlawful for ever for this reason shaking hands embracing and the like are permissible nevertheless on account of the fear of temptation one ought not to embrace her consider what is stated in the noble qur n al durr al mukht r states

the ruling on a husband and wife sitting in separate seats during air travel a woman travels with her husband but in the aeroplane the seats of the two of them are separate and this keeps happening will travelling in such a state be permissible or not in the case in question travelling in this manner is permissible and it will not be said that she has travelled without a ma ram because in the time of the prophet the companion women and the pure wives sometimes had separate mounts yes if the airline is informed at the time of booking the tickets they will seat them together or a request may be made to an unrelated passenger that he take the husband's place and the husband take that passenger's place so that he may sit beside his wife if even this is not possible then the woman should sit observing purdah and should not engage in free and easy conversation muslim shar f states

the ruling on divorce by saying if you go to your brother's house you are free a man said to his wife if you go to your brother's house you are free if she goes to her brother's house will divorce occur by these words or not and will the intention be taken into account in this or not in the case in question if the woman goes to her brother's house divorce will occur without any intention because the word free is generally used for divorce divorce will therefore occur and this word does not stand in need of an intention consider what is transmitted in fat w sh m

the ruling on suspending a divorce upon an impossible condition a father and his son disagreed about a girl's marriage the father said i will not give my daughter to zayd the son said if i do not marry my sister to zayd this year then three divorces upon my wife the year has now passed and the son was unable to marry his sister to zayd have three divorces fallen upon the son's wife or not in this question let this aspect also be kept in view whether in the presence of the girl's father the brother has any authority or power to give his sister in marriage or whether the girl herself has that authority in the presence of the father the brother has no authority to give his sister in marriage hence this belongs to the category of suspension upon an impossibility that is divorce was made contingent upon something that is not within his power furthermore if the girl is sane and adult she is her own mistress in the matter of her marriage if she marries within her equals permission is a sunnah and not a requirement yes if she marries outside her equals then the guardian's permission is necessary and the guardian is the father not the brother consider what is stated in al durr al mukht r

the ruling on divorce by saying i will issue a divorce a man said to his wife in a message on the telephone i will issue a divorce before the witnesses of our marriage he did not name anyone he then explained that he had said this so that his wife would take fright did divorce occur by these words or not the husband's words i will issue a divorce relate to the future therefore no divorce has occurred for the present since divorce does not take effect when it is pronounced in the future tense consider what is recorded in fat w hindiyyah tanq al fat w al midiyyah states

the duration of the waiting period of divorced girls who have not reached puberty it is stated in the noble qur n that the waiting period of those divorced girls who do not menstruate is three months some liberal minded scholars say that what is intended by this noble verse are those girls who are adult and married and who do not menstruate if they are then divorced their waiting period is three months and that a divorced minor is not intended now in the light of the sciences of the exegetes and the hadith scholars kindly make it clear that this verse comprises both the non menstruating minor and the non menstruating adult the purpose of these liberal minded people is to abolish the very concept of the marriage of a minor in the light of the hadiths and the statements of the exegetes this matter becomes as clear as broad daylight that what is intended by the said noble verse are both non menstruating minor girls and non menstruating adult girls consider the hadiths

the limits within which a man may use his shar right of divorce a man has grown weary of married life and wishes to know at what stage he ought to make use of the right of divorce in the pure shar ah the bond of marriage and the tie of married life is not a temporary one it is a bond of life and death it is required that the tie be honoured and maintained till one's dying breath for this tie is a firm means and instrument for passing a life of comfort tranquillity chastity and modesty moreover divorce is not the first remedy for unpleasantness and for discord between husband and wife rather divorce is the last stage in the effort to set matters right accordingly those elders of the family who possess understanding and good sense should be appointed as arbiters and an effort at reconciliation should be made and various measures should be employed neverthe

three divorces when two are given having forgotten the earlier divorce suppose a muslim because of an injury to his head cannot keep anything in mind when he performs wu he forgets even the wiping of the head and has to do it again and if he prays at home he forgets the number of units nothing stays in his memory such a man had in the past given his wife one divorce and had forgotten it now he has given his wife two divorces the earlier one not being in his mind at all and he says on oath that he did not remember the first divorce tell me has his marriage now come to an end that is have three taken effect or does the right of taking her back remain in the case in question three divorces have taken effect upon the wife of the man mentioned it is now not correct for them to marry without a valid shar al lah forgetting the earlier divorce is no shar excuse since he certainly remembers that he had given one before that one too will be counted and joined with the two new ones three irrevocable divorces have now taken place consider what is mentioned in fat al qad r

divorce taking effect by signing a written divorce in the distant past out of irreligiousness a man contracted his marriage under community of property the meaning of which is that whichever of the two spouses dies the survivor receives half of his or her estate this law is contrary to the islamic shar ah and he now wishes to bring it to an end but his lawyer has advised that a divorce will have to be given so if this man signs the lawyer's divorce document will divorce take effect or not in the pure shar ah just as divorce takes effect by pronouncing explicit words with the tongue so too it takes effect by signing a written divorce that has been drawn up the reason is that explicit words stand in need of no intention divorce takes effect without any intention or purpose even if the man did it for some expedient reason the noble jurists have however mentioned one situation in which divorce does not take effect if immediately after the divorce he says in sh all h or writes in sh all h together with his signature on the written divorce then divorce will not take effect in this way release from the legal divorce will also be obtained while in the eyes of t

divorce taking effect by saying if there is no reconciliation by nine o'clock tonight then the third divorce a man had earlier given his wife two divorces he has now said to his wife if we have not reconciled by nine o'clock tonight then i am issuing the third divorce now if there is no reconciliation will the third divorce take effect or not in the case in question if there is no reconciliation by nine o'clock at night the third divorce will take effect and the woman will become irrevocably forbidden to him thereafter it will not be permissible to marry her without a valid shar al lah consider what taby n al aq iq states divorce takes effect by a verb in the present tense see fat w d r al ul m zakariyy 4 45 mumbai edition

divorce by the words i give you a strong divorce a quarrel arose between a husband and wife in the course of the quarrel the matter escalated and the husband said to his wife i give you a strong divorce the meaning of which is a severe divorce which divorce has taken effect by these words in the case in question if the husband's intention was of one divorce then one irrevocable divorce has taken effect if his intention was of three then three will take effect and if no intention was present in his mind then it will be one irrevocable divorce

divorce by the words i do not want you in my life abdull h wrote these words to his wife i abdull h do not want n imah in my life what is the ruling now will divorce take effect or not in the case in question the words mentioned do not indicate divorce nor do they carry the possibility of divorce therefore no divorce will take effect by this sentence even with the intention note what al ba r al r iq states

divorce by saying go to hell two years ago i spoke with my wife on the telephone and during the argument i said to her in anger go to hell but i did not give her a divorce nor did i have any intention of giving a divorce my wife says that i divorced her and she made a false allegation against me and obtained a fatwa from some d r al ift in pakistan has divorce taken place or not in the case in question if the husband's statement above is based on truth and fact then no divorce has taken effect upon his wife because the words go to hell are among the metaphorical expressions and with metaphorical expressions of divorce no divorce takes effect without the intention divorce will not take effect merely because the wife says so or because a fatwa of divorce has been obtained

divorce by writing i divorce you in response to a demand for divorce a wife demanded a divorce from her husband and upon this demand of hers the husband sent a written message i divorce you has divorce taken effect by this written message or not when a person of his own free will writes out a divorce himself or has someone else write it divorce takes effect even if he has said nothing with his tongue because speaking is not a condition for divorce to take effect therefore in the case in question one revocable divorce has taken effect by the message mentioned note the evidence bad i al an i f tart b al shar i states durar al ukk m shar majallat al a k m states

an oath not to drink milk and drinking milk mixed with water a man swore an oath if i drink milk my wife is divorced he then mixed water with milk and drank it and it is not known whether there was more water or more milk will that man have broken his oath or not and will divorce take effect upon his wife or not in the case in question that man will not have broken his oath merely on account of a doubt and divorce will not take effect upon his wife note what bad i al an i records

the lineage of children after the prohibition of affinity has been established between spouses if after the prohibition of affinity has been established between spouses a child is born that is through marital relations will its lineage be established or not in the case in question this child's lineage will be established because on account of the difference of opinion among the jurists this intercourse does not carry the ruling of fornication note what al durr al mukht r states

a threat to apostatise as a form of coercion if a woman who is a new muslim pressures her husband thus if you do not give me three divorces i will become a christian again and apostatise does this come under coercion or not and if it is coercion is it the compelling kind or the non compelling kind outwardly the woman's saying that she will become an apostate if he does not give three divorces does not come under coercion coercion is of two kinds 1 compelling coercion where one is threatened with loss of life or the destruction of a limb 2 non compelling coercion where one is threatened with imprisonment but this statement of the woman does not come under coercion note what khiz nat al fiqh records shar man mat ibn wahb n states

denying desire in a case of the prohibition of affinity in a matter of the prohibition of affinity if a person denies that there was desire will the prohibition of affinity be established or not the jurists have generally written that if he kissed or touched a place that is only touched with desire the prohibition will be established despite his denial but some people have stated that if he denies desire the prohibition will not be established which is correct in the case in question some jurists have written that if he denies desire the prohibition of affinity will not be established note what al mu al burh n records fat w sh m states

children born after three divorces do not have established lineage a man gave his wife three divorces then out of heedlessness continued to have relations with her and children were born is the lineage of these children established or not in the case in question if he continued to have relations with her while knowing it to be unlawful this comes under the ruling of fornication and the children's lineage will not be established 2 if he had relations believing in his own estimation that it was lawful this is a doubt as to the act and in this case too the lineage will not be established 3 if that man asked a mufti for a verdict and acted upon it this is an accepted doubt and the children's lineage is established note what al durr al mukht r states

divorce given while the wife is intoxicated a woman is always in a state of intoxication her husband worn out by this gave three divorces at that time too the woman was intoxicated and she abused him and said get out of here the husband now wishes to know whether divorce took place in this state or not in the case in question three divorces have taken effect and it is now not permissible to marry this woman without a valid al lah according to the sharia a valid al lah is that after the waiting period this woman marries another man and then he divorces her or dies after she has completed the waiting period she may marry her first husband note that for divorce to take effect it is not even necessary for the wife to be present fat w d r al ul m deoband states question a man divorced his wife in her absence has divorce taken effect or not answer in this case divorce has taken effect upon his wife because it is not necessary for the woman to be present and nearby at the time

delegating the power of divorce to a d r al qa or to the jam iyyat al ulam a husband delegates assigns the power of divorce to the body of muslims that is to a d r al qa in these words if i am unable to appear before the d r al qa at the appointed time without a valid reason and without notice the d r al qa shall have the authority whenever it wishes to effect one irrevocable divorce upon my wife by delegating in this way will the d r al qa have the authority of divorce in the event of his non appearance or not and will this man have the right to withdraw from this statement of his or not please explain in detail with evidence in the case in question if the husband gave this authority to the body of muslims or to the d r al qa and signed their agreement to the effect that if he does not appear before the court session without a valid reason the d r al qa will have the authority to effect one irrevocable divorce upon his wife then according to the sharia this form will be called delegation and the d r al qa will have the authority to give divorce thereafter the husband cannot withdraw from his statement it will be for all time and it may also be made temporary for twenty five years for example and so on but because of signing this deed of delegation and agreement the husband's own right to giv

making a promise of divorce conditional a woman demanded a divorce from her husband the husband said if you are ready to have relations with me i will give the divorce the wife fulfilled the condition but afterwards the two were reconciled so did divorce take effect upon the fulfilment of the condition or not in the case in question no divorce took effect upon the fulfilment of the condition because the husband made a promise to give a divorce and when a promise of divorce is made conditional divorce does not take effect upon the fulfilment of the condition the husband's words i will give the divorce are words of the future tense and divorce does not take effect by such words note what all mah sh m may allah have mercy on him says

whether al lah lapses when a christian woman accepts islam after three divorces a muslim man married a christian woman then a quarrel arose between them and the husband gave his christian wife three divorces after that the woman became a muslim now if this woman wishes to marry her former husband will al lah be necessary or is marriage valid without it the requirement of al lah does not lapse on account of accepting islam or changing religion and marriage with the former husband does not become permissible without al lah therefore in the case in question a valid al lah is necessary for the christian woman to marry her former husband without it the marriage is not permissible note what al fat w al hindiyyah records the requirement of al lah does not lapse through a change of religion note what al durr al mukht r states

whether the wife becomes unlawful by swearing to make the lawful unlawful a man swore an oath in these words if i go to the gambling den in future then everything lawful is unlawful for me since it was an old habit he went there after some days what is the ruling on his oath now has his wife become unlawful or not given that he had no intention of divorcing his wife in the case in question he has broken his oath and expiation has become obligatory but as regards divorce falling upon the wife the earlier scholars say that without an intention no divorce will take effect while in the view of the later jurists one irrevocable divorce will take effect because of custom however some jurists for example all mah sh m may allah have mercy on him and all mah ibn nujaym al mi r may allah have mercy on him and others say that in our custom these words are not used for divorce so the intention will be taken into account and without an intention no divorce will take effect note that all mah sh m may allah have mercy on him says

investigation of a hadith about obeying one's husband a hadith about obeying one's husband has come to my hearing the summary of which is this a man went on a journey and told his wife not to go out of the house her father lived on the lower storey and he fell ill the woman sent someone to ask the prophet peace and blessings be upon him whether she could go to visit him in reply the prophet peace and blessings be upon him said obey your husband then her father passed away so she sent again to ask whether she could go to look upon her father's face the prophet replied obey your husband then the prophet sent word to that woman because of your obedience to your husband allah most high has forgiven your father is this accoun the above account is found in a few books of hadith but all its chains are weak whereas it is established in the quran and in many authentic hadiths that serving one's parents and visiting them when there is need is necessary allah most high said in the noble quran and further that is it is not permissible to obey any creature by displeasing the creator accordingly it is not intelligible that one should please one's husband by disobeying the command of allah and his messenger therefore this weak hadith carries no weight in the sharia the investigation of the hadith may be seen below 1

the ruling on three divorces during the waiting period of an apostate woman if a woman becomes an apostate and the marriage is annulled will a waiting period be obligatory or not and if the husband gives three divorces during the waiting period will the woman become irrevocably divorced or not in the case in question the waiting period is binding upon the woman and if he gave three divorces before the waiting period ended they will take effect and the woman will become irrevocably divorced but if he gave the three divorces after the waiting period ended they will not take effect because the woman has become like a stranger note what fat w sh m states see further fat w d r al ul m zakariyy 4 295 mumbai concerning the taking effect of divorce all mah sh m may allah have mercy on him has transmitted from the learned ibn al hum m may

the ruling on divorce by saying you are free as far as i am concerned a man had a quarrel with his wife and in a state of anger he said these words to her you are free as far as i am concerned go wherever you want to go but he does not know whether he said it three times or once did divorce take effect by these words or not if it did how many in the case in question the husband's words you are free as far as i am concerned go wherever you want to go are not explicit with regard to divorce therefore if the husband said these words with the intention of divorce one irrevocable divorce has taken effect and if he said them without an intention no divorce has taken effect note what al hid yah records

whether divorce takes effect by saying i am not married a married man was making sweet talk with a woman in the course of it the woman asked are you married he said i am not married did divorce take effect by these words or not in the case in question no divorce took effect by the husband's words i am not married but one should avoid using such doubtful expressions note what al mu al burh n records fat w ma m diyyah

the ruling on divorce by saying a young man who is unmarried said this sentence every woman is unlawful for me will his wife be divorced the moment he marries or not and what will the ruling be regarding his marrying in the hanafi school making the lawful unlawful is an oath therefore whenever this young man marries the expiation for an oath will be obligatory yes if by this sentence he intended to make a divorce conditional then when he marries divorce will take effect upon his wife but if he made no intention or he merely meant to give information the statement will be of no effect in al fat w al t t rkh niyyah a ruling of this kind has been transmitted from imam q kh n and from shaykh al isl m note the text

the ruling on saying if i have relations with you of my own accord you are unlawful to me like my mother a man said these words to his wife if i come to have relations with you of my own accord then you are unlawful to me like my mother if you come of your own accord there is no problem did ih r occur by these words or divorce if divorce occurred when and which kind please explain in detail with evidence in the case in question the husband's words quoted above you are unlawful to me like my mother carry the possibility of all three ih r divorce and l but when there is no intention of divorce then because of the particle of comparison they will be taken to mean ih r accordingly when the man in question comes to have relations of his own accord ih r will be established and its ruling is that he must free a slave if none is available he must fast for two consecutive months and if he is not able to fast he must feed sixty poor people two meals note what bad i al an i records

the ruling on using as an argument for an evil act nowadays some misguided people say 1 in the time of l peace be upon him sodomy was unlawful because they used to do it by force so if there is mutual consent there is room for it we seek refuge in allah 2 concerning they say that marrying the girls is a matter of greater purity as compared with sodomy and that there is room for sodomy too we seek refuge in allah what is the answer to this satanic question outwardly the people of l used to commit sodomy by consent because in the noble quran the words of coming to are used about these people and in the quran and the hadiths the word coming to is used for a consensual act thus concerning the people of l this verse is mentioned in the noble quran and you commit evil in your gatherings here it is quite plain that those people used to commit these evils by consent coming to means doing something with consent doing it by force is called compulsion or coercion and in this evil act the word of coercion is nowhere mentioned regarding the people of l and even supposing that in that age they used to do it

the ruling on giving a reward out of the donation money to someone who helps in collecting it what is the ruling on giving a gift from the madrasah's funds to a person who helps in collecting donations and the like for the madrasah that is if the madrasah's collector goes to some village for donations and some acquaintance there takes him along and gets donations made is it permissible to give him something as a gift out of the donations or not so that there may be encouragement for the future and help may be obtained in collecting the madrasah's money is not one's own personal property and a gift or present is given out of one's own personal property yes as for those gentlemen who are helpers of the madrasah and assist in obtaining donations there is room to give them something by way of a gift

the ruling on taking library books home to study there is a library to which people come to study some people wish to take the books home to study so according to the sharia will permission be given to take the library's books home to study or not in the case in question the conditions laid down by the endowers will be observed if the endowers have not permitted the books to be taken outside the trustee and supervisor will not give permission and if the endowers have given permission then it will be permissible to take them home with the permission of the trustee and supervisor yes returning them after study will be necessary and further if any transgression occurs those who took them will be liable note what all mah al al d n al a kaf may allah have mercy on him says in al durr al mukht r

the ruling on selling old copies from a library and buying necessary books in the library of a madrasah there are several copies of textbooks and non textbooks which the madrasah neither needs at present nor is there any likelihood of needing in future so will it be permissible to sell such old copies and buy other necessary books in exchange for them or not in the case in question the books that come into the general library of a madrasah are of three kinds 1 books bought by the madrasah which are not endowed 2 books bought by the madrasah which have been endowed 3 books received from outside which are generally endowments the ruling in all three of the above cases is that if the madrasah has no need of these books at present or in the future then it is permissible and correct to sell them at a suitable price and buy necessary books in exchange for them

the ruling on an endowment made by a non muslim and on his contributing to a mosque is the endowment of a non muslim valid or not if a non muslim wishes to give financial help to a mosque may it be accepted or not is it in any hadith that the prophet peace and blessings be upon him accepted the help of a non muslim in the case in question the endowment of a non muslim is valid provided that both the muslims and the non muslims regard it as a good and meritorious deed and provided further that there is no fear of any mischief in the non muslim's endowment in the same way it is also correct to accept his help for a mosque provided there is no fear of any kind of control over the mosque or of mischief later on and he is giving the help regarding it as an act of drawing near to god and of obedience note that all mah sh m may allah have mercy on him says all mah al ar bulus may allah have mercy on him says in al is f f

the ruling on making an endowment merely verbally without setting it apart from one's own property a man endowed a particular portion of his land for the building of a mosque and a madrasah this endowment is verbal there is no document and he has not had anything built on it is this endowment valid or not has the endowment been completed without setting apart the land of the mosque and the madrasah or not in the case in question the verbal endowment is valid a document is not necessary for an endowment to be valid yes the endowment of a mosque will only be valid when he sets it apart and since he has not set it apart the endowment of the mosque has not become valid though the endowment of the madrasah has become valid note what al hid yah records in cases oth

the ruling on trading in intoxicating powder beer powder a kind of powder is available which is called beer powder the method of using it is that it is put into water and left for twenty four hours and then that powder turns into intoxicating liquor is trading in it permissible or not in the case in question since the predominant use of this powder is in liquor for that reason one should avoid trading in it altogether yes trading in the four forbidden drinks unfermented grape wine fermented grape wine date wine and raisin wine is unlawful trading in the remaining intoxicants is not unlawful but it is disliked to the degree of prohibition and impermissible note what fat w sh m records

the ruling on taking employment as an accountant at a gambling house casino i am an accountant and various companies engage me for a fee at present a gambling company has called me for accounting work may i take up accounting employment for them will this salary be permissible for me or not in the noble qur'an allah most high has declared gambling and games of chance unlawful therefore keeping its accounts amounts to cooperating in it and cooperation in disobedience is impermissible on this basis one should abstain from such employment and taking its salary is likewise impermissible and sinful consider the noble qur'an states moreover in the noble ad th the one who keeps the accounts of interest has been made a partner in the sin of interest in the same way the one who keeps the accounts of gambling will be a partner in the sin of gambling consider what muslim shar f states

the ruling on a consignment sale a certain trade is run on the basis of consignment sale its procedure is that along with an ordinary sale the company grants certain purchasers the option that if they are unable to sell the goods after purchasing them they may return those goods to the company for the company this return of the goods is reckoned to come under iq lah can there be any scope in the shar ah for a sale of this kind or will it fall under a sale with a condition and so be impermissible nowadays most of the large companies in the world are engaged in this and on account of it purchasers are more inclined towards them many muslim traders too have adopted this method in the case described the correct manner of this transaction is that the condition of return should not be stipulated within the sale rather after the contract of sale has been concluded a promise should be made and entered in the documents as well a transaction of this kind will then be sound and correct and this condition will have the status of a promise its parallel is bay bi'l waf in which iq lah is certain and many scholars have given a fatw of permissibility for that sale the details of which may be seen in fat w d r al ul m zakariyy volume 5 in the light of that the above mentioned form will be permissible with even greater reason since in it iq lah is only a p

the ruling on a clearing agent is it permissible to do the work of a clearing agent and is it permissible to take the money received for it or not the meaning of a clearing agent is one who carries out the documentation and related procedures for imports into the country moreover if this agent pays a smaller amount to the administrators of the port and collects a larger amount from the importer and exporter for example he gave 1000 to the department and collected 1500 is it permissible for him to keep this excess amount for himself or not in the case described if that department and institution has fixed the salary of the clearing agent and the fee of the importer and exporter is also fixed by that institution and company then the agent cannot collect more yes if it has been stated on the part of the department that a specified amount for example 1000 rand must be given to them and that he may collect more from the importer then he will be permitted to keep the excess amount for himself consider what all mah al sarakhs may allah have mercy on him writes in al mabs

the ruling on taking a membership card from a company and earning points nowadays companies issue a card in the name of the customer by way of membership on account of which the customer receives special concessions in purchasing goods and points are also earned on purchases then at the end of the year a prize is given through the points or special concessions are received but in order to obtain this it is necessary to purchase goods from that company a number of times during the year so will it be permissible to obtain such a card and take the concessions or not in the case described obtaining a card from companies and acquiring conditional points or particular concessions upon it is permissible and correct in the terminology of fiqh this is called tabarru mashr a conditional gratuity consider a few proofs as follows muslim shar f states the gist of the above ad th is that a man presented an invitatio

the ruling on transit insurance is transit insurance permissible or not for example from south africa to botswana because last month a friend's vehicle was looted in which there were trade goods worth about two hundred thousand rand now he fears that such a thing may happen in the future as well so will it be permissible for him to take out insurance or not every insurance in which a larger sum is received in exchange for the sum deposited is impermissible yes if in exchange for the deposited sum the service of medical treatment is received or the repair of a car and the like then scope may be found for it outwardly in the case described money is received at the time when the trade goods are lost and more is received on this basis such a transaction is impermissible and one should keep away from it in our time insurance is in reality a combination of interest and gambling and both of these are impermissible in the sight of the shar ah muft kif yat all h ib says insuring shops factories and lives with insurance companies is im

the ruling on taking a fee for a letter of guarantee zayd is the owner of a company in japan he made an agreement with umar who is at present in pakistan that zayd would give umar a guarantee letter which is necessary for a japanese visa and that in exchange umar would come to japan and work with zayd in his company and give zayd 30 per cent of the profit and that if he did not wish to work with zayd he would give him seven hundred thousand rupees now is this agreement of zayd's correct in the sight of the shar ah or not and in the case of umar's not working with him will the seven hundred thousand be binding upon him to give to zayd or not kaf lah bi'l nafs and kaf lah bi'l m l are contracts of gratuity and it is not correct to take a fee for them in kaf lah bi'l nafs the person guaranteed for must be produced in court and in kaf lah bi'l m l the debt is discharged on behalf of the one guaranteed for thus in the case described zayd is giving a guarantee to the japanese embassy that i take responsibility for the following things on behalf of umar 1 the expenses of residence in japan 2 the expenses of the return journey 3 and adherence to all the laws of the japanese government this is pure kaf lah and taking a countervalue for it is not permissible therefore taking a payment for giving a guarantee letter is not

the ruling on paying a fixed amount at hotels and eating nowadays buffets are laid out in hotels and restaurants their form is that people come and pay a fixed amount and then eat as much as they wish from the various foods presented no quantity is specified is this permissible given that the item sold is unknown since it is not known who will eat how much some eat less and some eat more in the case described such a transaction is permissible and correct because the ambiguity in the item sold is not such as to give rise to a dispute moreover it is a matter of common dealing among people and for this reason there is no harm in it consider what takmilah fat al mulhim states

the ruling on profit in a joint business of a father and his sons it is widely believed among people that if brothers and sisters live together with the father and one brother among them holds a very important post in some factory and then the occasion for separation arises the other brothers and sisters are partners in all the wealth and the other things purchased by that employed brother is this correct or not or is the employed brother the owner of his own wealth in the case described the father and the sons live together and one son earns handsomely from his employment that earning is his own and no one else is a partner in it because it is he himself who does the work and not the other brothers and sisters in the qur'an the ad th and the books of fiqh there are many proofs from which it is learnt that the wage is the special portion of the hired worker and the employee and that no one else is a partner in it consider the noble qur'an states it is thus learnt that the wage is the property of the hired worker it comes in the ad th that the messenger of allah said

the ruling on a creditor giving a loan to a debtor at a benefit in the banks of some countries for example japan denmark and so on a certain method has been in operation its summary and upshot is that when the funds of the ordinary banks accumulate in large amounts in the central bank a certain percentage of it for example 0 1 has to be paid to the central bank for instance ten thousand on ten million and this is a large sum therefore the bank officials encourage people to take as much loan as possible and on repayment less has to be paid for example if one took a loan of one thousand one has to pay 990 and the bank waives 10 rand is this method permissible and is there no sin in taking the loan first this point should be borne in mind that an interest bearing loan is unlawful and impermissible in the eyes of the shar ah and an interest bearing loan means that the creditor having given a loan collects something extra upon it from the debtor that is a stipulated increase in wealth which is not the counter value of anything but in the case in question the creditor is remitting some portion of the debtor's loan this is a favour that is whoever takes a loan from the bank will have a certain percentage of his loan remitted this falls under the category of a voluntary gift a favour and a settlement and this is permissible consider it is in fat w sh m

the ruling on a settlement discount is a settlement discount permissible or not that is the seller says to the buyer if you pay the money within 30 days i will give you a 2 per cent concession and if you pay after 30 days you will have to pay the full amount in the case in question if such a condition is laid down at the outset then this transaction will not be permissible yes if a settlement is reached without a condition then there is scope for it in that the creditor did a favour to the debtor by reducing the amount and the debtor did a favour to the creditor by paying early likewise if he does not lay down a condition in the contract at the outset but merely makes a promise then too there is scope for it consider what is in fat w sh m
